description: Source code for a JSON marshaler/unmarshaler for protobuf messages, part of the grpc-gateway runtime package, implementing JSON encoding/decoding with support for protobuf types.

classes.name: JSONPb
classes.description: A marshaler for protobuf messages to/from JSON, supporting full protobuf functionality.

classes.name: DecoderWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around json.Decoder that adds support for protobuf unmarshaling.

methods.name: Marshal
methods.description: Marshals a Go value into JSON bytes.

methods.name: marshalTo
methods.description: Helper function to marshal a value to an io.Writer.

methods.name: Unmarshal
methods.description: Unmarshals JSON data into a Go value.

methods.name: NewDecoder
methods.description: Creates a new JSON decoder with protobuf support.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes JSON data into a protobuf message or other Go types.

methods.name: NewEncoder
methods.description: Creates a new encoder that writes JSON to an io.Writer.

methods.name: Delimiter
methods.description: Returns the delimiter byte sequence for newline-delimited JSON streams.
